spans.s: हर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. Bringing, conveying, R.xii.5, 11, Kir.v.50; 2. taking, seizing; 3. captivating; 4. removing, depriving of; 5. dividing.
हर (II) m. 1. Śiva, K.S.i.50, vii.44, Megh.i.7, 44; 2. fire; 3. an ass; 4. the denominator of a fraction (in math.).
हर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. Bringing, conveying, R.xii.5, 11, Kir.v.50; 2. taking, seizing; 3. captivating; 4. removing, depriving of; 5. dividing.

हार m. 1. Abstraction, deprivation; 2. a porter; 3. a necklace, हारममलतरतारमुरसि दधतं परिलंब्य विदूरम् Git.G.xi., स्तनैः सहाराभरणैः सचंदनैः Rt.i.4, R.vi.16; 4. a necklace of pearls, K.S.v.8, R.v.52; 5. war, battle; 6. the denominator of a fraction (in math.).
हर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. Bringing, conveying, R.xii.5, 11, Kir.v.50; 2. taking, seizing; 3. captivating; 4. removing, depriving of; 5. dividing.
हरि (I) a. 1. Green, greenish, हरिं विदित्वा हरिभिश्च वाजिभिः R.iii.43; 2. reddish brown, tawny, R.xii.84; 3. yellow.

हरि (II) m. 1. Viṣṇu, R.ix.57; 2. Indra, R.iii.55, 68, xii.103; 3. Śiva; 4. Yama; 5. Brahman (m.); 6. the moon; 7. the sun; 8. a ray of light; 9. fire; 10. wind; 11. a lion, R.ii.59; 12. a horse; 13. a horse of Indra, सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरींश्च वर्तंते वाजिनः Sak.i.; 14. the Indian cuckoo; 15. a parrot; 16. a peacock; 17. an ape, a monkey, R.xii.57, xv.99; 18. a frog; 19. a snake; 20. a name of the poet Bhartṛhari; 21. the yellow or golden colour.
हारि (I) a. Captivating, charming, beautiful.
हारि (II) f. 1. Defeat; 2. losing a game; 3. a caravan; 4. a traveller’s progeny.
हर-गौरी f. one of the forms of Śiva and Pārvatī conjoined.
हर-चूडामणि m. Śiva’s crest-gem, i.e. the moon.
हर-तेजस् n. quick-silver.
हर-नेत्र n. 1. Śiva’s eye; 2. the number ‘three’ (in math.).
हर-बीज n. quick-silver.
हर-शेखरा f. Śiva’s crest, i.e. the Ganges.
हर-सूनु m. 1. Skanda, R.xi.83; 2. Gaṇeśa.
हरण n. 1. The act of taking or seizing; 2. carrying off, removing, stealing, R.xi.74; 3. dividing (in math.); 4. a gift; 5. the arm.
हरि-अक्ष m. 1. a lion; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
हरि-अश्व m. 1. Indra; 2. Śiva.
हरि-कांत a. 1. dear to Indra; 2. beautiful as a lion.
हरि-गंध n. a sort of sandal.
हरि-चंदन (I) m.n. 1. a sort of yellow sandal, R.iii.59, vi.60, K.S.v.69, Sis.v.45; 2. one of the five trees of paradise, (the other four being पारिजात, मंदार, संतान and कल्प).
हरि-चंदन (II) n. 1. saffron; 2. moonlight; 3. the filament of a lotus.
हरि-ताल (I) m. a kind of pigeon.
हरि-ताल (II) n. yellow orpiment, K.S.viii.23, 33.
हरि-तालिका f. 1. the fourth day of the bright half of Bhādrapada; 2. the dūrvā plant.
हरि-तुरंगम m. a name of Indra.
हरि-दास m. a worshipper of Viṣṇu.
हरि-दिन n. a particular day sacred to Viṣṇu.
हरि-देव m. the asterism Śrāvaṇa.
हरि-द्वार n. name of a celebrated sacred bathing-place.
हरि-नेत्र (I) n. 1. the eye of Viṣṇu; 2. the white lotus.
हरि-नेत्र (II) m. an owl.
हरि-प्रिय (I) m. 1. the Kadamba tree; 2. Śiva; 3. a fool, a blockhead.
हरि-प्रिय (II) n. 1. a sort of sandal; 2. a conch shell.
हरि-प्रिया f. 1. Lakṣmī; 2. the earth; 3. the twelfth day of a lunar fortnight.
हरि-भुज् m. a snake.
हरि-लोचन m. 1. a crab; 2. an owl.
हरि-वल्लभा f. 1. an epithet of Lakṣmī; 2. the holy basil.
हरि-वासर m. Viṣṇu’s day, i.e. the eleventh day of a lunar fortnight.
हरि-वाहन m. 1. Garuḍa; 2. Indra.
हरि-शर m. an epithet of Śiva, (Viṣṇu having served Śiva as the shaft which set the cities of Tripura on fire).
हरि-सख m. a gandharva.
हरि-संकीर्तन n. the act of repeating the name of Viṣṇu.
हरि-सुत, -सूनु m. a name of Arjuna.
हरि-सुत, -सूनु m. a name of Arjuna.
हरि-हय m. 1. Indra, उपगतो विनिनीषुरिव प्रजा हरिहयोऽरिहयोगविचक्षणः R.ix.18; 2. the sun.
हरि-हर m. a particular form of deity consisting of Viṣṇu and Śiva conjointly.
हरि-हेति f. 1. the disc of Viṣṇu; 2. the rainbow, कथमवलोकयेयमधुना हरिहेतिमतीः (ककुभः) M.M.ix.
हरि-हेति˚हूति m. the ruddy goose.
हरिक m. 1. A horse of a yellowish colour; 2. a thief; 3. a gambler.
हरिण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Pale; 2. white.

हरिण (II) m. 1. A deer, an antelope; (five kinds of this animal are mentioned- ऋष्यः खड्गो रुरुश्चैव पृषतश्च मृगस्तथा), लक्ष्यीकृत्य हरिणस्य हरिप्रभावः R.ix.57, K.S.v.15; 2. a goose; 3. the sun; 4. Viṣṇu; 5. Śiva.
हरिण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Pale; 2. white.
हरिणी f. 1. A female deer, R.ii.11, Megh.ii.19, 41; 2. a golden image; 3. one of the four classes of women, otherwise called चित्रिणी; 4. yellow jasmine; 5. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
हरित (I) a. (f. हरिता or हरिणी) Green, of a green colour, नीपं दृष्ट्वा हरितकपिशम् Megh.i.21, Kir.v.38, K.S.iv.14.

हारिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Taking, conveying, robbing, वाजिकुंजराणां च हारिणः Yaj.ii.273; 2. obtaining, acquiring; 3. disturbing, seizing, M.xii.28; 4. delighting, pleasing, captivating, तुष्टे विष्टपहारिणीष्टदहरौ संप्राप्यते देहिना Bhartr.ii.25; 5. having a necklace.
हरिण-अक्ष a. deer-eyed, fawn-eyed.
हरिण-अक्षी f. a woman with beautiful eyes.
हरिण-अंक m. 1. the moon; 2. aamphire.
हरिण-कलंकधामन् m. the moon.
हरिण-कलंकधामन् m. the moon.
हरिण-दृश्, -नयन a. deer-eyed, fawn-eyed.
हरिण-दृश्, -नयन a. deer-eyed, fawn-eyed.
हरिण-हृदय a. timid, faint-hearted.
हरिणक m. A deer, क्व बत हरिणकानां जीवितं चातिलोलम् Sak.i.
हरिणी-दृश् a. fawn-eyed.
हरित् (I) a. 1. Greenish; 2. yellow, yellowish.

हरित् (II) m. 1. Green colour; 2. a swift horse; 3. a horse of the sun, सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरिंश्च वर्तंते वाजिनः Sak.i., or उत्पाट्य मेरुशृंगाणि क्षुण्णानि हरितां खुरैः K.S.ii.43; 4. a lion; 5. the sun.
हरित् (III) m.n. Grass.
हरित् (IV) f. A quarter, a point of the compass, R.iii.30.
हरित्-अश्व m. 1. the sun, R.iii.22, xviii.23, Kir.ii.46, Sis.xi.56; 2. the Arka plant.
हरित्-गर्भ m. green or yellowish kuśa grass with broad leaves.
हरित्-मणि m. an emerald, Sis.iii.45.
हरित्-वर्ण a. green-coloured.
हरित (I) a. (f. हरिता or हरिणी) Green, of a green colour, नीपं दृष्ट्वा हरितकपिशम् Megh.i.21, Kir.v.38, K.S.iv.14.
हरित (II) m. 1. The green colour; 2. a lion; 3. a kind of grass.
हरित (I) a. (f. हरिता or हरिणी) Green, of a green colour, नीपं दृष्ट्वा हरितकपिशम् Megh.i.21, Kir.v.38, K.S.iv.14.
हरिता f. 1. The Dūrvā grass; 2. a brown-coloured grape.
हारित m. 1. The green colour; 2. a kind of pigeon.
हारीत m. 1. A cheat, a rogue; 2. a kind of pigeon, R.iv.46; 3. the name of a writer of religious and civil law, Yaj.i.4.
हरित-अश्मन् m. 1. an emerald; 2. sulphate of copper.
हरित-च्छद a. having green leaves.
हरिद्रा f. 1. Turmeric; 2. the root of turmeric powdered, Mall. on Na.xxii.49.
हरिद्रा-आभ a. of a yellow colour.
हरिद्रा-गणपति, -गणेश m. a particular form of the god Gaṇeśa.
हरिद्रा-गणपति, -गणेश m. a particular form of the god Gaṇeśa.
हरिद्रा-राग a. unsteady in affection or attachment, fickle, (क्षणमात्रान्य्रागश्च हरिद्राराग उच्यते Hal.).
हरिय m. A horse of a yellowish colour.
हरीतकी f. The yellow myrobalan tree.
हर्तृ (I) a. (f. र्त्री) One who receives, takes away or seizes.
हर्तृ (II) m. 1. A robber; 2. the sun.
हर्तृ (I) a. (f. र्त्री) One who receives, takes away or seizes.
हर्मन् n. Yawning, gaping.
हर्मित a. (f. ता) 1. Yawned; 2. cast, thrown; 3. burnt.
हर्मित a. (f. ता) 1. Yawned; 2. cast, thrown; 3. burnt.

हर्म्य n. 1. A palace, a mansion, any large building, रम्यं हर्म्यतलं न किं वसतये Bhartr.iii.68, हर्म्याग्रसंरूढतृणांकुरेषु R.vi.47, Megh.i.32, K.S.vi.42, Bt.viii.36; 2. a fire place, a hearth; 3. the nether world.
हर्म्य-अंगन n. the court of a palace.

हर्ष m. 1. Joy, delight, glee, rapture, pleasure, gladness, happiness, exultation, सैनिकहर्षनिस्वनेः R.iii.61, or पुंस्कोकिलैः फलरसैः समुपात्तहर्षः Rt.vi.22; 2. joy considered as one of the 33 minor feelings (in rhetoric), हर्षस्त्विष्टाप्तेर्मनःप्रसादोऽश्रुगद्गदादिकरः S.D.iii.; 3. bristling, erection (especially of the hair, as in रोमहर्ष).
हर्ष-अन्वित a. full of joy.
हर्ष-उत्कर्ष m. excess of happiness, ecstasy.
हर्ष-उदय m. rise of joy.
हर्ष-कर a. gratifying, delighting.
हर्ष-जड a. paralyzed with joy.
हर्ष-विवर्धन a. promoting joy.
हर्ष-स्वन m. a cry of joy.
हर्षक a. (f. र्षका or र्षिका) Delighting, gladdening, delightful.
हर्षक a. (f. र्षका or र्षिका) Delighting, gladdening, delightful.
हर्षक a. (f. र्षका or र्षिका) Delighting, gladdening, delightful.
हर्षण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) Causing delight, pleasurable.
हर्षण (II) m. 1. An epithet of one of the five arrows of Kāmadeva; 2. a morbid affection of the eyes.
हर्षण (III) n. The act of delighting or making glad, e.g. स्तब्धाकर्षणदृष्टिहर्षणमहामंत्रः कुरंगीदृशाम्.
हर्षण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) Causing delight, pleasurable.
हर्षण (I) a. (f. णा or णी) Causing delight, pleasurable.
हर्षयित्नु (I) a. Gladdening, causing delight.
हर्षयित्नु (II) n. Gold.
हर्षुल m. 1. A deer; 2. lover.
हार-आवली f. a string of pearls, हारावलीतरलकांचितकांचिदाम केयूरकंकणमणिद्युतिदीपितस्य Git.G.xi.
हार-गुटिका f. the bead of a necklace.
हार-यष्टि f. a string of pearls, a necklace, कुचकलशरुचा हारिता हारयष्टिः Git.G.xii., Rt.i.8, ii.25.
हार-हारा f. a kind of grape.
हारक m. 1. A thief, M.xi.51; 2. cheat, a rogue; 3. a kind of prose composition; 4. a string of pearls; 5. a divisor (in math.).
हारि-कंठ m. the Indian cuckoo.
हारिणिक m. A hunter.

हारिन् a. (f. णी) 1. Taking, conveying, robbing, वाजिकुंजराणां च हारिणः Yaj.ii.273; 2. obtaining, acquiring; 3. disturbing, seizing, M.xii.28; 4. delighting, pleasing, captivating, तुष्टे विष्टपहारिणीष्टदहरौ संप्राप्यते देहिना Bhartr.ii.25; 5. having a necklace.
हार्द n. 1. Affection, love, उदितं प्रियां प्रति संहार्दामिति श्रदधीयत प्रियतमेन वचः Sis.ix.69; 2. kindness; 3. intention, meaning.

हार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. To be taken, to be borne, to be carried, वारणराजहार्यया K.S.v.70; 2. to be taken away, R.vii.67, xvi.43; 3. to be shaken, to be unsettled, K.S.v.8; 4. to be attracted, to be won over, to be influenced, K.S.v.53.
हार्य (II) m. 1. A serpent; 2. the bibhītaka tree; 3. the dividend (in math.).

हार्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. To be taken, to be borne, to be carried, वारणराजहार्यया K.S.v.70; 2. to be taken away, R.vii.67, xvi.43; 3. to be shaken, to be unsettled, K.S.v.8; 4. to be attracted, to be won over, to be influenced, K.S.v.53.
